# Phase 5: test-set evaluation

*Generated by `python -m solvia.pipeline --steps evaluate`. The models were chosen on validation in Phase 4; the test split was scored with them on 2026-10-28T03:52:48+00:00 (UTC). Model file hashes are in `reports/metrics/test_run_log.json`; a run with different model files is refused.*

## B. Expected solar output (Kaggle plants, test days 2020-06-13 … 2020-06-17)

Selected: `hist_gradient_boosting`, per_plant, trained on `healthy_reference`. Healthy inverter-days, both plants: test daily MAE **176.8 kWh** (MAPE 2.76 %, R² 0.964) vs validation 122.5 kWh; 15-minute daytime MAE 33.0 kW (R² 0.960).

Daily kWh per inverter-day, healthy inverter-days, both plants:

| model | split | eval_set | plant | n | mae | rmse | r2 | mape_pct |

| random_forest | test | healthy | both | 178 | 174.2 | 211.0 | 0.967 | 2.69 |
| hist_gradient_boosting | test | healthy | both | 178 | 176.8 | 220.1 | 0.964 | 2.76 |

Only 5 test days (the plants' data covers 34 days), so the test numbers are a check, not a precise estimate.

## A-India. Next-day consumption, Prayas eMARC (test 2020-01-01 … 06-30)

Selected in Phase 4: `ridge`. Test MAE **0.711 kWh/day** (validation 0.716), R² 0.909, MAPE 15.2 %; +4.7 % vs the best validation baseline (`baseline_mean_7d`).

MAE (kWh/day) of every baseline and model:

| model | kind | valid | test | test_normal | test_lockdown |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ridge | model | 0.716 | 0.711 | 0.673 | 0.748 |
| hist_gradient_boosting_relative | model | 0.726 | 0.757 | 0.679 | 0.830 |
| random_forest | model | 0.733 | 0.743 | 0.733 | 0.753 |
| hist_gradient_boosting | model | 0.749 | 0.793 | 0.776 | 0.809 |
| baseline_mean_7d | baseline | 0.763 | 0.746 | 0.694 | 0.796 |
| baseline_yesterday | baseline | 0.798 | 0.775 | 0.755 | 0.795 |
| baseline_last_week | baseline | 1.060 | 1.054 | 0.961 | 1.141 |

Lockdown (from 2020-03-25): selected-model MAE 0.673 on normal days vs 0.748 in lockdown (+3.1 % / +6.0 % vs baseline). Lockdown is a change in behaviour the training data never contained.

Per meter (test): median MAE 0.539 (baseline 0.568) over 104 meters; the model beats the baseline on 70% of meters (60% on normal days, 63% in lockdown).

**Meters seen in training vs new** (test)

| group | rows | meters | mean_kwh | mae | baseline_mae |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| new meter | 4088 | 28 | 6.09 | 0.897 | 0.912 |
| seen in training | 11964 | 76 | 4.89 | 0.648 | 0.690 |

**By household type** (test)

| group | rows | meters | mean_kwh | mae | baseline_mae |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Basic | 10335 | 67 | 4.84 | 0.679 | 0.706 |
| Water Heaters but no AC | 3257 | 20 | 5.88 | 0.743 | 0.791 |
| With Air Conditioners | 2460 | 17 | 5.76 | 0.805 | 0.855 |

**By region** (test)

| group | rows | meters | mean_kwh | mae | baseline_mae |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aurangabad | 3373 | 23 | 6.98 | 0.972 | 0.986 |
| Gonda | 1897 | 11 | 5.79 | 1.000 | 1.096 |
| Kanpur rural | 1534 | 10 | 3.29 | 0.543 | 0.558 |
| Pune | 3532 | 23 | 4.23 | 0.628 | 0.645 |
| Pune city | 5716 | 37 | 5.05 | 0.558 | 0.602 |

**80 % prediction interval (test):** raw quantile models cover 77.2% (width 2.40 kWh); after the conformal adjustment from validation (+0.08 kWh each side) 81.2% (width 2.57 kWh).

Calibrated coverage by period: lockdown 83.5%, normal 78.8%.

Calibrated coverage by household_type: Basic 80.2%, Water Heaters but no AC 83.9%, With Air Conditioners 82.3%.

## A-France. Next-day consumption, UCI household (test 2010-01-01 … 11-25)

Selected in Phase 4: `ridge`. Test MAE **4.259 kWh/day** (validation 4.566), R² 0.490, MAPE 18.4 %; +2.7 % vs the best validation baseline (`baseline_mean_7d`).

MAE (kWh/day) of every baseline and model:

| model | kind | valid | test |
|---|---|---|---|
| ridge | model | 4.566 | 4.259 |
| random_forest | model | 4.592 | 4.034 |
| baseline_mean_7d | baseline | 4.825 | 4.375 |
| hist_gradient_boosting | model | 5.158 | 4.505 |
| baseline_last_week | baseline | 5.825 | 5.879 |
| baseline_yesterday | baseline | 6.316 | 5.107 |

**80 % prediction interval (test):** raw quantile models cover 64.2% (width 8.95 kWh); after the conformal adjustment from validation (+2.68 kWh each side) 83.0% (width 14.31 kWh).

## Monitoring and maintenance (C, D)

These are rules on top of the expected-output model, not trained predictors, so they have no test split of their own. They were checked in Phase 4 with simulated faults (0 % false alarms; 99.8 % of 20 % losses caught in one day) and against the plants' own history; see `reports/monitoring_report.md`.
